image_description: A close-up, eye-level shot of a vintage typewriter keyboard. The focus is on the bottom row, specifically highlighting the elongated space bar which is cream-colored and rectangular. Above it are rows of round, black keys with white characters, some featuring green accents on the stems. The typewriter body is a muted sage green or grey metal. The background is a plain, out-of-focus off-white wall.
